entities.description: The ids of the entities that will be plotted.

parent.description: The parent {@link ReliabilityAsset} of the the model

baseModel.description: The {@link ReliabilityMlModel} being cloned, used to retrieve existing {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun}.

trainingDatasetTimeRanges.description: Selected {@link TimeRange}s to be shaded as training ranges.

validateDatasetTimeRanges.description: Selected {@link TimeRange}s to be shaded as validation ranges.

nonOperationalMaskRules.description:
Selected exclusion rules based on sensor value ({@link ReliabilityDataPreparationRuleMaskSpec}).
Will be used to create time ranges that will shade the exclusions area on the chart together with
`exclusionDates`.

exclusionDates.description: Selected {@link TimeRange}s to be shaded as exclusion ranges.

plotStart.description: Starting {@link DateTime} for the chart's X-axis.

plotEnd.description: Ending {@link DateTime} for the chart's X-axis.

interval.description: String representing the {@link Interval} for the chart's data.

keepPreviousMasks.description: Flag to plot existing {@link ReliabilityMlMaskPreparationSpec} from the #baseModel when plotting.

cvExclusionsSettings.description:
Settings for Control Valves (CV) exclusion masks.
Should include the following properties:
- isAssetNotOperationalMaskSettings: ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationSpec
- enableMaintenanceDatabaseFilter: boolean

`isAssetNotOperationalMaskSettings` should include the following fields from {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationSpec#createExclusionMaskFeature}
(at least the disabled/enabled flags if the masks are disabled)
- extremeValueExclusionDisabled: boolean
- extremeValueBounds: Pair<double, double>
- stpExclusionEnabled: boolean
- stpExclusionPeriodCount: double
- manualModeDisabled: boolean
- almostConstantExclusionEnabled: boolean
- almostConstantExclusionMinDuration: double
- almostConstantExclusionAbsChange: double
- fTFExclusionEnabled: boolean
- fTFExclusionLag: int
- fTFExclusionDelay: int
- fTFExclusionThreshold: double
